hints.title: Exploration via Backtracking DFS
hints.text: The robot has no access to the full grid initially. You must explore all reachable cells using depth-first search while recording cell costs.

hints.title: Backtracking Reverse Move
hints.text: whenever the robot moves to an adjacent cell, record the movement cost and backtrack by moving in the opposite direction.

hints.title: Dijkstra on Explored Graph
hints.text: after building the graph of reachable cells and locating the target, execute Dijkstra algorithm from the starting cell (0, 0) to find the minimum cost path.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Backtracking DFS explores reachable cells, followed by min-heap Dijkstra shortest path.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Attempting to find the shortest path without full exploration risks greedy dead-ends or sub-optimal paths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: DFS explores at most 400 cells in O(V + E) time, and Dijkstra priority queue executes in O(V log V) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should decompose the interactive problem into graph exploration (DFS) followed by shortest path (Dijkstra).
